project.name: gritty-lots
project.description: Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite monorepo with an admin app and shared packages for UI, auto-routing, data schemas, and a page-neural editor. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: badge.vue
nodes.summary: Thin Vue wrapper around ant-design-vue Badge that forwards attrs and all named/default slots under the gritty-neural-badge class.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 script-setup SFC that dynamically re-emits every slot via v-for on useSlots().

nodes.name: button.vue
nodes.summary: Neural button wrapper over ant-design-vue Button that optionally renders a NeuralIcon in the icon slot and applies flex centering styles.

nodes.name: checkbox.vue
nodes.summary: Passthrough Vue wrapper around ant-design-vue Checkbox that binds attrs and forwards all slots with the gritty-neural-checkbox class.

nodes.name: configProvider.vue
nodes.summary: Passthrough wrapper around ant-design-vue ConfigProvider used to theme and configure descendant Neural UI components.

nodes.name: icon.vue
nodes.summary: Named NeuralIcon that looks up Lucide icons from a local register, applies default size/stroke, and emits click from an accessible button.
nodes.languageNotes: Resolves icons dynamically via computed lookup into the register map and renders with Vue's <component :is>.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel that re-exports data-schema Neural UI wrappers and aliases ant-design-vue message and theme as NeuralMessage and NeuralTheme.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript barrel using named re-exports; ant-design-vue message/theme are aliased rather than wrapped as SFCs.

nodes.name: input.vue
nodes.summary: ant-design-vue Input wrapper that adds an optional bottom-border-only style via the bottomBorder prop.

nodes.name: inputNumber.vue
nodes.summary: ant-design-vue InputNumber wrapper that can stretch to full width when block is true and forwards all slots.

nodes.name: popConfirm.vue
nodes.summary: Passthrough Vue wrapper around ant-design-vue Popconfirm that forwards attrs and slots under gritty-neural-popconfirm.

nodes.name: popover.vue
nodes.summary: Passthrough Vue wrapper around ant-design-vue Popover that forwards attrs and all named/default slots.

nodes.name: radio.vue

nodes.name: radioButton.vue

nodes.name: radioGroup.vue

nodes.name: optGroup.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports ant-design-vue Select.OptGroup as NeuralSelectOptGroup so Select can still recognize grouping markers.
nodes.languageNotes: OptGroup is a data component (renders null) with isSelectOptGroup; wrapping it in an SFC would break dropdown groups.

nodes.name: select.vue
nodes.summary: ant-design-vue Select wrapper that supports a block full-width layout, exposes focus/blur/getSelectRef, and styles option content alignment.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses defineExpose to forward the inner Select instance methods; unscoped dropdown styles target .ant-select-dropdown.

nodes.name: selectOption.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports ant-design-vue Select.Option as NeuralSelectOption so Select can identify option children from VNodes.
nodes.languageNotes: Option is a data component (renders null) with isSelectOption; an SFC wrapper would hide options from Select.

nodes.name: App.vue
nodes.summary: Admin app root that renders only a RouterView so layout and pages come from the Vue Router tree.

nodes.name: CodeBlock.vue
nodes.summary: Documentation code snippet component that prefers a code prop over slot content so template whitespace is not stripped, with sm/md size styles.

nodes.name: DocSection.vue
nodes.summary: Lightweight documentation section wrapper that renders a titled heading and a default slot for demo content.

nodes.name: Draggable.vue
nodes.summary: Absolutely positioned drag wrapper built on VueUse useDraggable, with optional initial position, parent-or-custom container bounds, and a disabled state.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets inheritAttrs: false and resolves containerElement in onMounted because the parent DOM is not available during setup.

nodes.name: Iconify.vue
nodes.summary: Clickable Iconify icon wrapper that builds a sized icon component from a name prop via the createIcon factory.

nodes.name: create-icon.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that returns a Vue component wrapping @iconify/vue Icon for a given icon name.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses defineComponent plus h() so each icon name becomes a distinct named component.

nodes.name: createIcon
nodes.summary: Builds a Vue component that renders an Iconify Icon for the supplied icon name, forwarding attrs into the render function.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Admin components Vue plugin that globally registers Iconify, DocSection, CodeBlock, and Draggable, and attaches $createIcon on app.config.globalProperties.
nodes.languageNotes: install() loops a components map with app.component and exposes createIcon as a global property.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: vue-i18n setup for zh-CN/en-US with localStorage persistence, HTML lang updates, and a useLocale composable wrapping t, locale, and setLocale.
nodes.languageNotes: Composition API mode (legacy: false); locale is read from localStorage and written back on setLocale.

nodes.name: getLocale
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted locale from localStorage and falls back to zh-CN.

nodes.name: setLocale
nodes.summary: Switches the active vue-i18n locale, persists it to localStorage, and updates document.documentElement.lang.

nodes.name: useLocale
nodes.summary: Composable that returns vue-i18n t and locale plus setLocale for components that need language switching.

nodes.name: index.ts

nodes.languageNotes: beforeEach fetches dynamic routes once via the Pinia route store, then redirects; afterEach/onError finish or error the progress bar.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports the Button Vue component and defines CVA buttonVariants covering variant, size, shape, danger, and ghost compound styles.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses class-variance-authority with a large compoundVariants matrix so danger and ghost override base variant colors.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel that re-exports the Icon Vue component as the named Icon export.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports the Input Vue component, CVA inputVariants for size and prefix/suffix padding, and the InputStatus type.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines JSON Schema types compatible with draft-07 through 2020-12, plus DataSchemaProps for the schema editor component.
nodes.languageNotes: Type-only module: JSONSchema aliases JSONSchemaObject, covering combinators, conditionals, object/array/string/number keywords, and $ref/$defs.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Provides helpers to create default schema fields, test JSON Schema types, and import or export schema JSON files in the browser.

nodes.name: createField
nodes.summary: Builds a new schema field with an optional name (or a timestamp suffix) and a default string JSON Schema object.

nodes.name: is
nodes.summary: Checks whether a JSON Schema type is exactly the given type or includes it when the type is an array.

nodes.name: exportJSON
nodes.summary: Serializes a JSON Schema object to a pretty-printed file and triggers a browser download via a temporary object URL.

nodes.name: importJSON
nodes.summary: Reads a File as UTF-8 text, parses it as JSON, and rejects with i18n messages when the file is empty or invalid.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Vue I18n integration for the data-schema package: merges built-in zh-CN/en-US messages and supplies a fallback translator when no host i18n exists.
nodes.languageNotes: Stores a module-level i18n instance; mergeI18nMessages uses lodash-es merge so host keys win over library defaults.

nodes.name: fallbackT
nodes.summary: Walks dotted keys against the built-in zh-CN catalog and returns the original key when no translation is found.

nodes.name: useNeuralI18n
nodes.summary: Returns the host Vue I18n t/locale pair when mergeI18nMessages has run, otherwise a fallback translator and zh-CN locale.

nodes.name: mergeI18nMessages
nodes.summary: Registers the host i18n instance and deep-merges library locale messages so existing app keys take precedence.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Vue plugin entry that registers the GrittyJsonSchema component and merges the package i18n messages into the host app.
nodes.languageNotes: Default-export Vue plugin with an install(app, options) hook.

nodes.name: core.ts
nodes.summary: Recursively turns RouteJsonConfig trees into vue-router RouteRecordRaw entries, resolving page loaders, unique names, dynamic params, and nested group configs.
nodes.languageNotes: Walks dir/group vs page types and looks up Vite glob loaders by both [name].vue and [name]/index.vue paths.

nodes.name: createRoutes
nodes.summary: Builds RouteRecordRaw nodes from JSON configs, converting bracket params to vue-router params and recursing into group routes.json or nestedRoute children.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Package entry that generates auto routes, filters them by permission, mounts them on a parent route, and installs a Vue plugin with a v-permission directive.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue plugin default export registers $createAutoRoutes and a v-permission directive that hides elements when `${flag}:${action}` is missing.

nodes.name: createPermissionRoutes
nodes.summary: Flattens nested permission data then filters generated auto-routes to those the current user may access.

nodes.name: dealMountRoute
nodes.summary: Sets the parent route redirect and dynamically addRoute-s generated children under the given mount point.

nodes.name: createAutoRoutes
nodes.summary: Merges defaults with user options, generates the full route tree, optionally permission-filters it, applies redirects, and mounts when requested.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for auto-route plugin install options, JSON page configs, glob page maps, and breadcrumb records.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Helpers that flatten permission trees, filter routes by access, attach button-permission lists, and set parent redirects.

nodes.name: getKey
nodes.summary: Reads a permission comparison key from a route's meta or top-level fields.

nodes.name: isObject
nodes.summary: Returns true when the value is a plain object via Object.prototype.toString.

nodes.name: isString
nodes.summary: Returns true when the value is a string via Object.prototype.toString.

nodes.name: dealPermissionBtns
nodes.summary: Collects `${routeId}:` permission strings onto the route meta as permissionBtnList unless button permission is disabled.

nodes.name: createNewRoute
nodes.summary: Clones a route and overlays matching permission record path, name, and meta while resetting children for recursion.

nodes.name: dealPermissionRoutes
nodes.summary: Recursively keeps routes whose permission key matches, attaches page button permissions, and rebuilds the allowed child tree.

nodes.name: dealRoutesRedirect
nodes.summary: Recursively sets each parent redirect to a redirectToMe child or the first child when children exist.

nodes.name: flattenTree
nodes.summary: Flattens nested permission objects or primitive ids into a one-level array keyed for route matching.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and workspace manifests to see that gritty-lots is a Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite pnpm monorepo.

tour.title: Admin App Entry Point
tour.description: The product boots in @gritty-lots/admin: main.ts creates the Vue app, App.vue mounts the shell, and the router wires file-based views.

tour.title: Auto-Route Engine
tour.description: The auto-route package scans views, reads routes.json metadata, and generates Vue Router records used by the admin app.

tour.title: Shared UI Kit
tour.description: Reusable presentational components, Tailwind styles, and composables live in @gritty-lots/ui and are consumed by the admin app.

tour.title: Data Schema Kit
tour.description: @gritty-lots/data-schema builds JSON-schema-driven forms and controls with AJV validation; the core Vue surface is the editor entry.

tour.title: Page Neural Editor
tour.description: page-neural is a Vue Flow visual editor that composes schema components into an editable page/flow graph.

tour.title: File-Based Views
tour.description: Admin pages under src/views are discovered by auto-route. The playground Vue page is a good example of a generated route target.

tour.title: CI Deploy Pipeline
tour.description: GitHub Actions builds and deploys the admin app when changes land on the default branch.
